Bundles the 11 trivial rational-range hypotheses fed to `theorem_5_1_from_thresholds` and `theorem_5_1_at_p_explicit`. All are provable by `norm_num` in Lean; the runner verifies them as a sanity check that the chosen `(η, p, r, r_mid, M)` tuple satisfies the preconditions of the generic theorem.

Position of log(1+√2) within the rational sandwich. When `log_in_window` is True, the sandwich is consistency-only — every Theorem 5.1 γ > log(1+√2) is automatically inside the window. To make `KG_upper_val_rat = π/(2·gamma_lo_rat)` strictly tighter than KrivineBound, `gamma_lo_rat` must instead be > log(1+√2), which would require a 38+ digit precision rational.

Numerical witness for `h_gap_ratio_at_p_explicit_with_B_phi`: at p = 1e-30, with a generous B_phi ≤ M_val+1 = 4001, the gap-ratio inequality `p · (|B_phi| + Cr_val + 1) · 91 < (sinh(9/10) - 1)/2` holds with massive margin (LHS ~ 1e-13, RHS ~ 0.013).

Numerical witness for `h_p_explicit_lt_pr_paper`: p_explicit_rat = 1e-30 is strictly below the certified Rouché radius `certify_invertibility.p_certified` (~2.4e-4), and `pr_paper` from the IFT package dominates the Rouché radius. The Lean axiom claims the latter; this is the closest direct numerical witness available.

Braverman.Effective.h_M_oracle.description: Single-M sup-norm bound: |H_0|, |H_η|, |H_0'|, |H_η'| ≤ M_val on the explicit oracle rectangle Ω(δ_val, B_val).

Braverman.Effective.h_oracle_domain_cont.description: F_inv_paper(disk r_val) lands in the explicit rectangle Ω(δ_val, B_val) for every q ∈ (0, pr_paper).

Braverman.Effective.h_eta_strict_improve.description: (H_η(I)/I).re > log(1+√2) at η = eta_val. Witnesses Theorem 4.4's strict improvement.

Braverman.Effective.h_gamma_explicit_san.description: Rational sandwich on the Theorem 5.1 γ-witness: gamma_lo_rat < gamma_explicit < gamma_hi_rat. `gamma_explicit` is now extracted from `theorem_5_1_at_p_explicit` whose `(η, p)` matches the certified-arb pipeline, so this axiom is the assertion that the IVT-chosen γ at `p = 1e-30` falls in the rational window around `solve_gamma.gamma_best` — verified numerically via `gamma_best_in_lean_sandwich`.

Braverman.Effective.h_p_explicit_lt_pr_p.description: p_explicit_rat = 1e-30 is below the IFT-package threshold `pr_paper eta_val r_val …`. Witnessed indirectly by checking `p_explicit_rat < certify_invertibility.p_certified ~ 2.4e-4`, since `pr_paper` dominates Step 1's certified Rouché radius.

Braverman.Effective.h_F_p_deriv_at_p_exp.description: deriv (F_p eta_val p_explicit_rat) 0 ≠ 0 at p = 1e-30. Justified analytically: F_p = (1-p)·H_0 + p·H_η, so `deriv(F_p)(0) = (1-p)·H_0'(0) + p·H_η'(0) ≈ H_0'(0) ≈ 1` for p = 1e-30. No direct runner witness; this is a structural fact about F_p at small p.

Braverman.Effective.h_gap_ratio_at_p_exp.description: Existence of B_phi compactness bound + gap-ratio inequality at p_explicit_rat. With the generous B_phi ≤ M_val + 1, the LHS at p = 1e-30 is on the order of 1e-13, well below the RHS ≈ 0.013.

Braverman.Effective.h_summability_at_p_e.description: Sign-structure conclusion at p_explicit_rat: any F_inv satisfying the Lemma 5.4 approximation has summability_fn F_inv (log(1+√2)) < 1. This is `summability_fn_at_log_lt_one` applied at p = 1e-30 < p_β. Witnessed indirectly: `solve_gamma` at p = 1e-30 finds γ with summability_fn = 1 strictly above log(1+√2), implying summability_fn < 1 below γ (and hence at log(1+√2)).

__theorem_5_1_from_thresholds_preconditi.description: Non-axiom numerical preconditions of `theorem_5_1_from_thresholds` at the chosen tuple. Each is discharged by `norm_num` in Lean; the runner cross-checks them to catch tuple-mismatches early.
